name: Talk with my data
goal: I talk with my Prism about my life and it answers from my own data, so I understand more and can decide
done: Asking 'What is going on with Robin?' answers in a sentence from the person's own items, links to where it came from, and offers the decision in front of them as one press

measure.says: share of questions answered in a sentence, with sources, that the person did not have to rephrase
